newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle market quiet, no trade-private.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle market quiet, no trade-private.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle bids at $108.00 to $109.00 per cwt on a dressed basis were passed by owners asking $111.00 to $112.00, market sources said.
There were no reported bids for cattle on a live basis, but owners were pricing cattle from $69.00 to $70.00.
Not many sales were expected following active trade Wednesday afternoon at $111.00 to $112.00 and $69.00, steady with the previous week, the market sources said.
There were about 60,000 head sold Wednesday, which brought the week to date number near 75,000, they said.
